data.title: Orbital Nexus Battle Pass: February 10 – March 23
data.summary: A new Battle Pass and upcoming changes.
data.meta_title: Orbital Nexus Battle Pass: February 10 – March 23
data.meta_description: A new Battle Pass and upcoming changes.
data.content:
FortEvo stole what was never meant to be copied.

From fragments of Volta’s Titan blueprint, Norna was forged — ushering in a new, unforgiving cycle of orbital warfare. The Orbital Nexus Battle Pass invites pilots to seize experimental firepower, hardened cosmetics, and rare intel as the battlefield shifts skyward once again.

Progress through Shipments to unlock powerful Titan, gear, and visual customizations inspired by stolen schematics and orbital conflict.

Orbital Nexus Battle Pass

The Orbital Nexus Battle Pass features the new assault Titan—Norna—and many other valuable rewards, including Salvage, Credits, Intel, cosmetics, and battle gear!

Battle Passes are only available for a limited time during Seasons. New Shipments of rewards will become available while the Battle Pass is active. You need to complete the Battle Pass while it’s available to unlock everything it has to offer!

  • Battle Pass (Free): Progress without spending a penny! Battle Tokens can be earned through battles and used to level up your Pass. You won’t be able to unlock every reward from all Shipments unless you upgrade to Battle Pass Gold.
  • Battle Pass Gold (200 WarpReals): Upgrade to Battle Pass Gold to earn enough Battle Tokens to obtain every item from the Battle Pass.

Shipment 1

There is no Battle Token requirement to unlock this Shipment.

  • Norna (Titan)
  • 3x Slugger Weapons
  • 1x Zenit Weapon
  • Kinetic Pulse Supply Gear
  • Concrete Dust Weathering
  • Blind Path Sticker
  • Ghost Circuit Sticker
  • Mitsuo Paint
  • Credits
  • Salvage
  • Intel

Shipment 2

Spend 12 Battle Tokens in Shipment 1 to unlock this Shipment.

  • Titan Mystery Sticker
  • Zealous Paint
  • Fortified Mycelium Decal
  • Death by Robots Sticker
  • Fortified Fiber Decal
  • Worn Metal Weathering
  • Iron Veil Cycle Gear
  • 2x Slugger Weapons
  • 1x Zenit Weapon
  • Credits
  • Salvage
  • Intel

Shipment 3

Spend 24 Battle Tokens in Shipment 1 and 2 to unlock this Shipment

  • Victorious Lion Sticker
  • Cyan Purple Paint
  • Desert Reliquary Paint
  • Tideborn Aegis Paint
  • Volcanic Ash Weathering
  • 3x Slugger Weapons
  • 1x Zenit Weapon
  • 1x Iron Veil Cycle Gear
  • Credits
  • Salvage
  • Intel

Shipment 4

Spend 49 Battle Tokens in Shipment 1, 2, and 3 to unlock this Shipment.

  • 260  Intel

Please note that you can’t own two Nornas. Purchasing it while you already have one will result in a loss of Battle Tokens. If you accidentally purchased Norna while already owning it, please contact our Support team.

Upcoming Changes

Battle Token Conversion Change

Starting in Season 4, all unspent Battle Tokens at the end of a season will be automatically converted to Intel instead of Credits. Conversion rate:

  • 1 Battle Token = 6 Intel

Be sure to plan your progression accordingly as you move through Orbital Nexus and beyond.

Battle Pass Gold for Platinum Pioneer Pack Holders

All promised Battle Passes have now been delivered. Starting with Season 4, you will no longer find free Battle Pass Gold in your inventory. While the original commitment was for 8 Battle Passes, a decision was made to make Season 3 fully free for Pioneer Pack holders, resulting in a total of 9 Battle Passes delivered.

Starting with Season 4, you will no longer find free Battle Pass Gold in your inventory.

Previously granted Battle Passes include:

  • Season 1
    • Under The Wire Battle Pass
    • Smuggler’s Run Pass
  • Season 2
    • Power Surge Battle Pass
    • Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass
    • Dei Ex Machina Event Pass
  • Season 3
    • The Web We Weave Battle Pass
    • Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass
    • Damage Resistance Battle Pass
    • No Place to Hide: Event Pass

Thank you again for your continued support — we truly appreciate it.
